# csplit

Split text at line numbers or regular-expression matches through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/csplit -f part- input.txt 3

moonx cli/csplit -s -f section- input.txt '/^SECTION/' '{*}'
```

Create numbered fragments and print byte counts by default. Repeat patterns, custom suffixes and suppression of boundary records are supported.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f VALUE`, `--prefix VALUE` | Set the output filename prefix. Default: `xx`. |
| `-n VALUE`, `--digits VALUE` | Set the minimum suffix width. Default: `2`. |
| `--suppress-matched` | Omit the offset-adjusted split boundary line. |
| `-s`, `--silent` | Suppress output byte counts. |
| `-k`, `--keep-files` | Keep created fragments after a split error. |
| `-z`, `--elide-empty-files` | Omit empty output fragments. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Existing output files are refused; input may be spooled. Windows output names ending in a dot or space are rejected.
- On errors, created fragments are removed unless -k requests keeping them.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
